# aiprovider_job (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Command executed by the job.
- `name` (String) Name of the job. Must be unique.

### Optional

- `priority` (Number) Job priority. Must be >= 0. Defaults to 0.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-generated unique identifier of the job.
- `status` (String) Server-computed job status (e.g. queued).
